subject: pathology
title: Skin pathology: blistering, papulosquamous disease and tumours

steps.tx: **Pemphigus vulgaris** (intraepidermal **suprabasal** split, **fishnet IgG** on direct immunofluorescence, flaccid bullae with **oral erosions** and **Nikolsky sign**, desmoglein 3 and 1 antibodies) is treated by **steroids with rituximab** (steroid sparing, B cell depletion); paraneoplastic (lymphoma, bronchiolitis obliterans) and drug induced (penicillamine, captopril) mimic. **Bullous pemphigoid** (**subepidermal tense bullae** sparing mucosa mostly, **linear IgG with C3** at basement membrane, elderly, BP180 and BP230) needs less aggressive steroids with doxycycline or dapsone; mortality lower. Level of split decides.
steps.say: Flaccid oral blisters Nikolsky positive are pemphigus: rituximab. Tense elderly sparing mouth are pemphigoid: gentler.

steps.tx: **Dermatitis herpetiformis** (intensely itchy extensor vesicles, **granular IgA** at dermal papillae tips, gluten sensitive with coeliac overlap, **dapsone** relieving itch in days) is managed by gluten free diet long term; **linear IgA disease** (drug induced vancomycin, string of pearls blisters) differs by linear pattern. Porphyria cutanea tarda (photosensitivity with milia, HCV and alcohol, phlebotomy) blisters metabolically; epidermolysis bullosa (mechanobullous, genetic) splits by level neonatally.
steps.say: Itchy extensor clusters granular IgA are herpetiformis: dapsone days, diet life. Vancomycin pearls are linear IgA.

steps.tx: **Psoriasis** (parakeratosis with **Munro microabscesses**, regular acanthosis, **Auspitz bleeding** on scale removal, extensor elbows and knees with scalp and nails, arthritis) steps from topicals and phototherapy to **methotrexate**, ciclosporin, acitretin and biologics (anti TNF, IL-17, IL-23); pustular (von Zumbusch, hypocalcaemia) and erythrodermic variants admit. **Lichen planus** (sawtooth rete, **Wickham striae**, violaceous polygonal papules with wrists and hepatitis C link, oral erosive premalignant) contrasts; **erythema multiforme** (**target lesions** with HSV trigger) versus **SJS and TEN** (mucosal Nikolsky, **SCORTEN**, culprit drug stopped, burn unit care) completes urgent rashes.
steps.say: Silvery extensor Auspitz is psoriasis: topicals to biologics. Violaceous polygonal Wickham is lichen planus.

steps.tx: **Basal cell carcinoma** (pearly rolled edge with telangiectasia, **peripheral palisading**, PTCH Gorlin syndrome, rarely metastasises) is excised or Mohs (face); **squamous cell carcinoma** (**keratin pearls**, actinic keratosis precursor, Marjolin ulcer, lip and ear worse, nodes dissect) needs wider margins with radiotherapy backup. **Melanoma** (**ABCDE**, **Breslow thickness** staging, sentinel node, **BRAF with MEK inhibitors**, checkpoint immunotherapy) kills if missed; lentigo maligna (elderly face), nodular (vertical fast), acral lentiginous and amelanotic variants deceive. Sunscreen with mole mapping prevents.
steps.say: Pearly palisading never mets is BCC: Mohs face. Keratin pearls actinic is SCC. Ugly duckling changing mole: Breslow stages.
